svg.aria-label: Final training loss after 3 epochs as a function of learning rate, for four optimizers, on log-log axes
svg.title: Final training loss after 3 epochs as a function of learning rate, for four optimizers, on log-log axes

text.tspan: How sensitive is each optimizer to its learning rate?
Mean of 3 seeds, 63 minibatches of 32 per epoch. Only the learning rate varies within each line.
